title: Software Engineer | Golang, React, AWS, Kafka, SQL or NoSQL | Bangalore | 8 to 12 Years
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer to develop software aligned with Cisco’s Design Thinking Principles, focusing on simplification and user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute technical documentation, and address software issues. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong technical expertise and a background in secure coding practices.
description:
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Who we are:

Security Cloud Control transforms security operations with its cloud-native design and AI-driven features. By consolidating security and automating tasks like device provisioning and policy updates, it improves visibility, scalability, and efficiency. It provides unified management for Hybrid Mesh Firewall, a highly distributed security fabric that stops advanced threats, protects applications, and enforces zero trust segmentation across data centers, campuses, and IoT environments.

Additionally, Security Cloud Control enables Zero Trust Access, ensuring seamless zero trust enforcement across cloud and on-premises environments. By converging network and security, it delivers a simplified experience for hybrid workforces with consistent ZTNA policies enforced per application.

Your Impact:

Advanced experienced professional using standard methodologies and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services.

Works independently but receives minimal guidance and direction from leader then determines best approach to accomplish work.

Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience.

Understands project and/or department needs and establishes relationships with appropriate multi-functional collaborators to gather input, collect information and complete work steps.

May lead projects from end-to-end through delegation, review, and getting results holistically.

May lead medium features from technical design through completion.

May contribute to a defined software engineering roadmap.

Identifies and recommends improvements to the software development lifecycle and best practices in agile engineering.

Leads delivery of high-quality design of features and deliverables.

Finds opportunities for multiple products to work together to create value for customers.

Integrates product sense as it relates to design of the product (market awareness, production adoption, competition) and tracks related metrics.

Writes functional clean code and unit tests with no guidance.

Maintains and enhances solutions by fixing complicated errors, raising risks, and escalating issues where necessary.

Minimum Qualifications:

+7 Years of Relevant experience into Full Stack Development major focus Backend

Requires solid conceptual and practical knowledge in primary Technology into Golang development and Java Script (React)

Strong Experience into cloud technologies majorly on AWS

Hands on Experience into either SQL or NOSQL Date base along with Kafka
 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience into Security Products or Networking products

Exposure on IAM or RBACK will be a great added advantage

Experience into Data pipelines like ETL , Data bricks etc
